_comment: PixelLab boss sheets copied from dungeon-platformer (its enemies/ai_provenance.json, 2026-07-13) and RENAMED on copy: stone_guardian.png was basalt_sentinel_ai.png, riftmaw.png was riftmaw_ai.png. Both are 768x640 sheets of 128px cells, rows idle(4) walk(6) tell(4) attack(6) hurt(4), frames bottom-anchored per frame (vertical only). Schema per entry: file, tool, method, prompt, ids, date, notes, origin.

entries.method: Base: create_1_direction_object 128px sidescroller, style-matched to the riftmaw_ai boss idle frame + the basalthorn pet sheet at 2x (quantized), candidate 1 of 4. Clips: v3 animate_object jobs, keep_first_frame=false; rows idle(4) walk(6) tell(4) attack(6) hurt(4), 128px cells, per-frame bottom anchor (vertical only).
entries.prompt: (the basalt sentinel brief — a basalt stone golem boss, sidescroller view — exact wording not recorded in the source file; style images were the riftmaw boss idle frame and the basalthorn pet sheet)
entries.origin: copied from dungeon-platformer assets/ai_placeholder/sprites/enemies/basalt_sentinel_ai.png (renamed; record: the 'basalt_sentinel' block of enemies/ai_provenance.json)
